apps.name: Circle Tap
apps.author: dev-du-futur
apps.description: Press OK just as the spinning cursor crosses the coloured arc. Every hit speeds it up and flips its direction. Easy, Medium and Hard, a Zen mode and six shaped maps.

apps.name: Infinite Stacker
apps.author: dev-du-futur
apps.description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can: press OK to drop each one, and whatever hangs over the edge is cut off. Five perfect drops in a row start golden mode, where perfect blocks grow back.

apps.name: Inkwave
apps.author: dev-du-futur, after Inkwave by Jayden Davis
apps.description: Turf War in blocky 3D: you and 3 bots against 4 bots for 3 minutes on Tidewater Plaza. Ink the ground, swim through your ink as a squid, splat the other team. Spritzer, Swell Roller or Glint Charger, plus bombs. Based on Inkwave (MIT).

apps.name: TinyChat
apps.author: dev-du-futur
apps.description: A small chatbot that runs on the calculator itself, with no connection. Ask it questions, chat, or get jokes. Maths, primes and unit conversions are calculated exactly.

variants.label: Small
variants.description: 2.1M-parameter model. Leaves room for other apps.

variants.label: Full
variants.description: 3.7M-parameter model. Better answers, takes most of the space.

apps.author: Mason363 (NumPlay)
